models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description: Registered customer accounts with email/password authentication credentials. This is the core customer identity table that authentication sessions, password resets, and email verifications reference. Profile information (display name, phone number) is stored in the separate {@link shopping_mall_customer_profiles} table. Customers can delete their accounts, which preserves orders and reviews for legal and seller record purposes while removing profile data.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all customers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for authentication. Never store plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft deleted. Null means account is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for customer authentication with access and refresh token support. Tracks login sessions with device information and expiration timestamps for security management.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for API authentication.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client device at login time.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL href of the client application at login time.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header from the login request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for automatic invalidation.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for customer password recovery. Each token is single-use with expiration time for security. When customer requests password reset, a new token is generated and sent via email. Token becomes invalid after use or expiration.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to customer email.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Token invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was used for password reset. Null if unused.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for customer registration confirmation. Each customer receives a unique token upon registration that must be verified before account activation. Tokens expire after a configured time period for security.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent to customer's email address.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp after which verification is no longer valid.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when email was successfully verified. Null until verification completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null for active records.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description: Registered seller accounts with email/password authentication credentials. This table stores the core seller identity used for authentication. Shop profile information including shop name, description, and logo is stored in {@link shopping_mall_seller_profiles}. Seller approval workflow is tracked in {@link shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for seller authentication and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last profile update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for account deletion.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for seller authentication with access and refresh token support. Tracks login sessions for sellers with session metadata and expiration. Each session belongs to exactly one seller and is created during login, expired during logout or timeout.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client that created this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL where the login was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the login page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expires. Sessions are invalidated after this time for security.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for seller account recovery. Generated when sellers request password reset via email, contains secure token and expiration timestamp. Tokens are single-use and automatically expire after configured duration. Managed through authentication flows, not direct CRUD operations.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure random token for password reset verification.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp after which reset is invalid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for seller registration confirmation. Stores temporary tokens sent to seller email addresses during the registration process. Each token is single-use and expires after a configured time period. Once the seller clicks the verification link, the token is marked as used and the seller account becomes active.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent via email.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was used for verification, null if not yet used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrators
models.description: Administrator accounts with email/password authentication credentials. Administrators manage seller approvals, categories, products, orders, and user accounts. This table serves as the parent entity for administrator sessions and password reset tokens.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for authentication and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for administrator authentication with access and refresh token support. Tracks login sessions for administrators with session metadata including IP address, request URL, and referrer. Sessions are append-only audit trails managed through authentication flows.

plainFields.name: access_token_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed access token for session validation and revocation.

plainFields.name: refresh_token_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed refresh token for token rotation and session extension.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client that created this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL path where the login was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the login page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for administrator accounts. Generated when administrators request password recovery, sent via email, and validated during password reset. Tokens expire after a short time window for security. Each token is unique and can only be used once.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to administrator's email.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Token is invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means active record.

models.name: shopping_mall_super_administrators
models.description:
Super administrator accounts with elevated system privileges for managing administrator promotions, demotions, and full system oversight.

Super administrators can promote regular administrators to super administrator grade and demote other super administrators to regular administrator grade. They cannot demote themselves. This table stores authentication credentials and is referenced by administrator_grade_changes for audit trail.

plainFields.name: email

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last profile update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for account deactivation.

models.name: shopping_mall_super_administrator_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for super administrator authentication with access and refresh token support. Tracks login sessions for security audit and session management.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for API authentication.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client that created this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL where the login was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from the login request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expires and becomes invalid.

models.name: shopping_mall_super_administrator_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens with expiration for super administrator password recovery. Tokens are single-use and expire after a configured time window for security.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to the super administrator's email.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp after which the reset link becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_profiles
models.description: Customer profile information extending basic authentication with display name and phone number. Each customer has exactly one profile linked to their identity in {@link shopping_mall_customers}. Profile data is editable by the customer and changes are tracked in {@link shopping_mall_customer_profile_snapshots} for audit trail.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Customer's public display name shown in orders, reviews, and profile pages.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Customer's contact phone number for order notifications and support.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_profiles
models.description: Seller shop profile information extending the seller actor with business-facing details. Contains shop name, description, and logo image that customers view. Each seller has exactly one profile (1:1 relationship). Approval status is tracked separately in shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Unique constraint enforces 1:1 relationship.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Public-facing shop name displayed to customers.

plainFields.name: description

plainFields.name: logo_image_uri

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots of seller profile changes preserving shop name, description, and logo at each modification point. Used for audit trail and dispute resolution. Each snapshot represents the complete state of a seller profile at a specific moment in time.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Shop name at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Shop description at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: logo_image_uri

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_profile_snapshots
models.description: Immutable point-in-time snapshots of customer profile changes for audit trail and data recovery. Each snapshot captures the display name and phone number at the moment of profile modification, enabling historical reconstruction and dispute resolution. References {@link shopping_mall_customer_profiles} and {@link shopping_mall_customers}.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Snapshot of customer's display name at time of change.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Snapshot of customer's phone number at time of change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created (when profile was modified).

models.name: shopping_mall_addresses
models.description: Customer shipping addresses storing recipient name, phone number, street address, city, state/province, postal code, country, and default designation flag. Each customer can have multiple addresses with one marked as default for checkout convenience.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description: Core product listings in the shopping mall catalog. Each product represents an item for sale with a name, description, category classification, and base price. Products are owned by sellers who create and manage them. Products can have multiple variants (SKUs) representing different option combinations, multiple images for display, and maintain an immutable snapshot history of all modifications for dispute resolution. When deleted, products are hidden from search and category listings but snapshots and historical order data are preserved.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name displayed to customers.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description with specifications and features.

plainFields.name: base_price

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was soft-deleted. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description: SKU variants representing specific option combinations for products. Each variant has a unique SKU code, optional price override, and tracks stock through inventory records. Variants are managed through their parent product and can be deleted only if no pending orders exist.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique stock keeping unit identifier for this variant.

plainFields.name: price_override
plainFields.description: Optional price that overrides the parent product's base price. Null means use base price.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was soft deleted. Null means active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_option_definitions
models.description: Configurable option type definitions for products such as Color, Size, or Material. Each product can have multiple option definitions, and each definition has multiple available values stored in {@link shopping_mall_product_option_values}. Option definitions are managed through their parent product and are deleted when the product is deleted.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Option type name such as 'Color', 'Size', or 'Material'.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: shopping_mall_product_option_values
models.description: Available values for product option definitions such as Red, Blue, Large, Small. Each value belongs to exactly one option definition and is used to construct product variant option combinations.

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.description: Junction table linking product variants to their selected option values. Each variant can have multiple option values representing its specific configuration (e.g., Color=Red, Size=Large). This enables flexible product option combinations without hardcoding option types.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Zero-based ordering index where 0 is the main thumbnail image displayed first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image was uploaded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshots
models.description: Immutable audit trail preserving complete product state at each modification point. Captures product name, description, category assignment, and base price at the moment of change. Each snapshot is permanently stored for dispute resolution and historical reconstruction. Related variant states are captured in {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshot_variants}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category's {@link shopping_mall_categories.id} at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: name

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: base_price

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshot_variants
models.description: Variant states captured within product snapshots for complete historical reconstruction. Each record preserves the SKU code, price override, and stock quantity of a variant at the moment the parent product snapshot was created. Immutable audit trail for dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: SKU code of the variant at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: price_override
plainFields.description: Price override value at the time of snapshot. Null means base price was used.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Stock quantity of the variant at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot variant was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots of product variant states capturing SKU code, price override, and option combinations at each modification point. Provides complete audit trail for individual variant changes, enabling historical reconstruction of variant states for dispute resolution and compliance. Each snapshot is linked to a specific product variant and preserves the exact configuration at the time of change.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: SKU code at the time of snapshot, uniquely identifying this variant configuration.

plainFields.name: price_override
plainFields.description: Price override at the time of snapshot, null if using product base price.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created, recording when the variant state was captured.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_inventory_records
models.description: Immutable audit trail of all stock quantity changes for product variants. Each record captures a single stock movement with quantity_change (positive for restocking, negative for orders or adjustments), reason explaining the change, and timestamp. Current stock quantity is calculated by summing all quantity_change values for a variant. Records are automatically created on order placement, cancellation, refund, and manual seller adjustments.

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: Stock quantity change amount. Positive for restocking, negative for orders, cancellations, or adjustments.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for the inventory change such as restock, order placement, order cancellation, refund, or manual adjustment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshot_variant_options
models.description: Junction table linking product snapshot variants to their option values, capturing the exact option combination at the time of product snapshot. Each record represents one option value (e.g., Color: Red) associated with a snapshot variant. Multiple records per snapshot variant form the complete option set (e.g., Color: Red + Size: Large). Enables reconstruction of historical variant configurations for dispute resolution and audit purposes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_option_value_id
foreignFields.description: Option value's {@link shopping_mall_product_option_values.id} at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot variant option association was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshot_options
models.description: Junction table capturing the exact option combination (e.g., Color: Red, Size: Large) for each product variant snapshot, enabling complete historical reconstruction of variant configurations at any point in time. Links {@link shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots} to {@link shopping_mall_product_option_values}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this option association was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this option association was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this option association was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_records
models.description: Immutable audit trail of all stock quantity changes for product variants. Each record captures a single stock movement event with quantity change (positive for restocking, negative for orders/adjustments), reason categorization, and timestamp. Current stock quantity is calculated by summing all quantity_change values for a variant. Records are automatically created during order placement, cancellation, refund processing, and manual seller inventory adjustments. This table follows append-only pattern - records are never updated or deleted.

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: Stock quantity change amount. Positive values for restocking, negative values for orders, cancellations, refunds, or adjustments.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason code for the inventory change. Examples: 'restock', 'order', 'cancellation', 'refund', 'adjustment', 'loss'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory change was recorded.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description: Junction table linking customers to saved products with creation timestamp for paginated display and sorting. Automatically removes entries when products are deleted or customers delete their accounts.

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was added to wishlist, used for sorting and pagination.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description: Shopping carts for customers, providing a persistent workspace for items before checkout. Each customer has exactly one active cart that persists across sessions. Cart items are stored separately in {@link shopping_mall_cart_items} with variant references and quantity tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Individual items in shopping carts, each referencing a specific product variant with quantity and price snapshot at time of addition.

Cart items are subsidiary entities managed through their parent {@link shopping_mall_carts}. Each item represents a specific product variant with a defined quantity and unit price captured at the time of addition. The unique constraint on (cart_id, product_variant_id) ensures the same variant cannot appear multiple times in a cart; instead, quantities are combined when adding the same variant again.

Price is denormalized as a snapshot to maintain consistent display and checkout calculation even if the product variant's price changes later. Temporal fields track item lifecycle with soft delete support via deleted_at.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of this variant in the cart.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Unit price snapshot at time of adding to cart, used for consistent display and checkout calculation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was added to the cart.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was soft deleted (removed from cart). Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description: Customer purchase transactions with order number, order date, and immutable shipping address snapshot. Order status is derived from order_items (paid/shipped/delivered/cancelled/refunded). Each order belongs to one customer and contains one or more order items.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique order number for customer-facing reference and support lookup.

plainFields.name: ordered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was placed.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Recipient name from shipping address at time of purchase (immutable snapshot).

plainFields.name: recipient_phone
plainFields.description: Recipient phone number from shipping address at time of purchase (immutable snapshot).

plainFields.name: street_address
plainFields.description: Street address from shipping address at time of purchase (immutable snapshot).

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City from shipping address at time of purchase (immutable snapshot).

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: State/province from shipping address at time of purchase (immutable snapshot).

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal code from shipping address at time of purchase (immutable snapshot).

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country from shipping address at time of purchase (immutable snapshot).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp (orders are typically never deleted for legal purposes).

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description: Individual purchased variants within orders with quantity, price, and status tracking. Each order item represents one SKU purchased by a customer, linked to its parent order, product, variant, and seller. Status is tracked independently per item to support individual cancellation and refund workflows. Price is snapshotted at purchase time to preserve transaction state.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units purchased for this variant.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Unit price at time of purchase, snapshotted to preserve transaction state.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Individual item status: paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, or refunded.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order item was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots preserving complete product, variant, and seller profile state at time of purchase for dispute resolution and audit trail. Each order item has exactly one snapshot capturing the exact state when the order was placed. References related entities: {@link shopping_mall_order_items} for the source order item, {@link shopping_mall_products} for product details, {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} for variant information, {@link shopping_mall_seller_profiles} for seller shop information.

plainFields.name: product_name
plainFields.description: Snapshot of product name at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: product_description
plainFields.description: Snapshot of product description at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: variant_sku_code
plainFields.description: Snapshot of variant SKU code at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: variant_price
plainFields.description: Snapshot of variant price at time of purchase, may override product base price.

plainFields.name: seller_shop_name
plainFields.description: Snapshot of seller's shop name at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: seller_shop_logo
plainFields.description: Snapshot of seller's shop logo URL at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created (purchase time).

models.name: shopping_mall_order_item_snapshot_variant_options
models.description:
Junction table linking order item snapshots to their selected product option values, capturing the exact option combination (e.g., Color=Red, Size=Large) at time of purchase for normalized querying and 1NF compliance.

References {@link shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots} for the snapshot containing variant state at purchase time, and {@link shopping_mall_product_option_values} for the specific option values. Each row represents one option value assigned to an order item snapshot, enabling proper 1NF normalization instead of storing composite option strings.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipments
models.description: Shipments representing packages sent by sellers with tracking information and delivery status. Each shipment can contain multiple order items from the same seller. All items in a shipment share the same tracking information. Customers confirm delivery per shipment, or items auto-confirm after 14 days from shipping.

plainFields.name: tracking_carrier
plainFields.description: Name of the shipping carrier (e.g., FedEx, UPS, DHL).

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Tracking number provided by the carrier for package tracking.

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was sent out by the seller.

plainFields.name: confirmed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer confirmed delivery. Null if not yet confirmed (auto-confirmed after 14 days from shipped_at).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: shopping_mall_shipment_logs
models.description: Immutable audit log of shipment lifecycle events including status changes, tracking updates, and delivery confirmations. Each entry records the event type, actor who triggered it, status transition, and contextual metadata. Append-only table for compliance and dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of shipment event: 'created', 'tracking_updated', 'delivery_confirmed', 'auto_delivered'.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who triggered the event: 'customer', 'seller', 'administrator', 'system'.

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: ID of the actor who triggered the event. Stored as plain field for historical integrity.

plainFields.name: old_status
plainFields.description: Previous shipment status before this event. Null for initial creation events.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: New shipment status after this event.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: Additional context about the event such as carrier name, tracking number, or delivery confirmation details.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this log entry was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipment_items
models.description: Junction table associating order items with shipments. Each order item belongs to exactly one shipment, while shipments can contain multiple order items from the same seller. All items in a shipment share the same tracking information and delivery confirmation status.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp when item was added to shipment.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for data retention and recovery.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description: Customer reviews with ratings for purchased products. Each review links a customer to a product they purchased through a specific order. Enforces one review per product per order constraint. Reviews can be edited (creating snapshots) and soft-deleted while preserving historical data for dispute resolution.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: Purchase order's {@link shopping_mall_orders.id} containing the reviewed product.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Star rating from 1 to 5 stars.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Optional review text content describing customer experience.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was soft-deleted, null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots preserving previous rating and text content when reviews are edited. Each snapshot captures the complete state of a review at a point in time for audit trail and dispute resolution. References {@link shopping_mall_reviews} for the current review state.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Review rating from 1 to 5 stars at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Optional review text content at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_requests
models.description: Customer cancellation requests for individual order items with paid status before shipping. Each request targets one order item and includes a reason text. Sellers review and respond to requests with approval or rejection. Approved requests trigger item cancellation and stock restoration via inventory records.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer's reason for requesting cancellation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current approval status: pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots capturing cancellation request state when seller responds. Each snapshot preserves the request status, customer reason, seller response, and timestamp for audit trail and dispute resolution. References {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_requests}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} who responded to this cancellation request.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Cancellation request status at time of snapshot: pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer's cancellation reason provided in the request.

plainFields.name: response_reason
plainFields.description: Seller's response reason for approval or rejection. Null if pending.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_requests
models.description:
Customer refund requests for delivered order items. Customers can request refunds within 7 days of delivery. Sellers review and approve or reject each request with a response reason. Approved refunds restore stock quantities via inventory records.

Each refund request is associated with exactly one order item and initiated by the customer who placed the order. The request remains in pending status until a seller responds with either approval or rejection. Sellers provide a response reason explaining their decision. The {@link shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots} table preserves immutable snapshots of refund request state when sellers respond.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} who responded to this request. Null if no response yet.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer's reason for requesting the refund.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status: pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: response_reason
plainFields.description: Seller's explanation for the approval or rejection decision. Null if pending.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund request was submitted.

plainFields.name: responded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller responded to the request. Null if pending.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots of refund request state created when sellers respond to refund requests. Preserves the complete state including customer's reason, request status, seller's response, and response timestamp at the moment of snapshot creation. Used for audit trail and dispute resolution. Append-only and cannot be modified or deleted.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer's reason for requesting refund at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Refund request status at time of snapshot (pending, approved, rejected).

plainFields.name: seller_response
plainFields.description: Seller's response text or rejection reason provided when responding to the refund request.

plainFields.name: responded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller responded to the refund request, creating this snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests
models.description: Seller registration requests submitted for administrator review with current approval status. Each request represents a seller's application to gain selling privileges on the platform. Administrators review and approve or reject requests, providing rejection reasons when applicable. Tracks submission and review timestamps for workflow management.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} who submitted the approval request.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator's {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id} who reviewed the request. Null until request is reviewed.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current approval status: pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by administrator when request is rejected. Null for pending or approved requests.

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller submitted the approval request.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator reviewed the request. Null until review occurs.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null for active records.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_approval_request_snapshots
models.description: Immutable audit trail preserving complete state of seller approval requests at each modification point. Each snapshot captures the approval status, rejection reason (if applicable), administrator who reviewed, and timestamp. Used for dispute resolution and historical tracking of the approval workflow. References {@link shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests} as parent, {@link shopping_mall_administrators} for reviewer, and {@link shopping_mall_sellers} for seller ownership.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator's {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id} who reviewed this request at snapshot time.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} who submitted the parent request at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Approval status at the time of snapshot: pending, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Administrator's rejection reason if status is rejected, null otherwise.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator reviewed and created this snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_promotion_requests
models.description:
Administrator promotion requests submitted by users (customers or sellers) to gain admin access. Super administrators review and approve or reject these requests.

Uses polymorphic ownership pattern with actor_type discriminator. Specific actor relationships are managed through subtype tables: {@link shopping_mall_admin_promotion_request_of_customers} for customer submitters and {@link shopping_mall_admin_promotion_request_of_sellers} for seller submitters.

Status workflow: pending (awaiting review) → approved (granted admin access) or rejected (denied by super administrator).

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Discriminator indicating which actor type submitted this request (customer or seller). Used with subtype tables for polymorphic ownership.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: User's written justification for requesting administrator role promotion.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current approval workflow status: pending (awaiting review), approved (granted admin access), or rejected (denied by super administrator).

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Explanation provided by super administrator when rejecting a request. Null for pending or approved requests.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the promotion request was submitted.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was last modified (e.g., status changed).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null for active requests.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_promotion_request_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots capturing the complete state of administrator promotion requests at each status change point. Each snapshot preserves the actor type, status, decision reason, and responding super administrator at the moment of change, providing an audit trail for dispute resolution and compliance. References {@link shopping_mall_admin_promotion_requests}.

foreignFields.name: responding_super_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Super administrator who made the decision's {@link shopping_mall_super_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who submitted the request: customer or seller.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Request status at snapshot time: pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Decision reason provided by super administrator, required for rejected requests.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_grade_changes
models.description: Immutable audit trail of administrator grade changes when super administrators promote or demote other administrators. Records transitions between regular administrator and super administrator grades for accountability and system oversight.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: The administrator whose grade was changed. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_super_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: The super administrator who performed the grade change. {@link shopping_mall_super_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: previous_grade
plainFields.description: The administrator's grade before the change: 'administrator' or 'super_administrator'.

plainFields.name: new_grade
plainFields.description: The administrator's grade after the change: 'administrator' or 'super_administrator'.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional reason or note for the grade change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the grade change was recorded.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_promotion_request_of_customers
models.description: Subtype table linking administrator promotion requests to customer actors. Implements polymorphic ownership pattern where the main admin_promotion_requests table holds common fields and this table provides the customer-specific foreign key relationship. Each promotion request is linked to exactly one customer actor.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. The customer who submitted the promotion request.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Customer session's {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id}. Audit trail of which session was used to submit the request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the subtype record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the subtype record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft delete. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_promotion_request_of_sellers
models.description: Subtype table linking administrator promotion requests to seller actors. Implements polymorphic ownership pattern where each promotion request is associated with exactly one seller. The unique constraint on shopping_mall_admin_promotion_request_id enforces 1:1 relationship, ensuring a request cannot be linked to multiple sellers.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_promotion_request_id
foreignFields.description: Target's {@link shopping_mall_admin_promotion_requests.id}. Unique foreign key enforcing 1:1 relationship between promotion request and seller.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Target's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. The seller who submitted the promotion request.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_session_id
foreignFields.description: Target's {@link shopping_mall_seller_sessions.id}. The seller session used when submitting the request, for audit purposes.
